citation_heritage_auc.description: Dense embeddings must recover citation heritage better than random (0.5) and exceed TF-IDF citation-based baseline (0.71-0.74)
citation_heritage_auc.note: All dense variants exceed 0.75 threshold; dense EXCEEDS TF-IDF citation-based (0.71-0.74)

cross_lang_same_branch_sachverhalt.description: Cross-lingual same-branch neighbor rate for Sachverhalt (facts) section must exceed 0.2
cross_lang_same_branch_sachverhalt.note: Facts section shows strongest cross-lingual alignment; Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen hierarchy confirmed

cross_lang_same_branch_dispositiv.description: Cross-lingual same-branch neighbor rate for Dispositiv (holdings) section must exceed 0.1
cross_lang_same_branch_dispositiv.note: Holdings section shows moderate cross-lingual alignment

cross_lang_same_branch_erwaegungen.description: Cross-lingual same-branch neighbor rate for Erwaegungen (reasoning) section must exceed 0.1
cross_lang_same_branch_erwaegungen.note: Reasoning section is most language-specific; fundamental limitation confirmed

jurist_pairwise_preference.description: Dense embeddings must pass jurist pairwise preference adversarial gate
jurist_pairwise_preference.note: FAILS at ALL scales tested (3yr: 0.005, 15yr: 0.288, 19yr: 0.37, 22yr: 0.43). Dense embeddings are COMPLEMENTARY VIEWS ONLY, not primary navigation mode.

linear_hybrid_results.description: Linear combinations of dense + TF-IDF at 22-year scale
linear_hybrid_results.note: Linear hybrids PASS adversarial gates but REMAIN BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.78-0.79). Optimal weight shifts toward TF-IDF dominance at scale.

true_oos_jurist_preference_ceiling.note: No representation achieves factory target under true out-of-sample conditions

v18_coarse_hierarchy.note: Even at 4-label branch level, best purity 0.65 < 0.70 threshold

overall_assessment.tfidf_174k_baseline: FROZEN as production baseline (8 reps, all PASS adversarial gates, best JP=0.7345)
overall_assessment.dense_embedding_role: COMPLEMENTARY VIEWS ONLY (citation heritage, cross-lingual alignment)
